events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Last few class D engines withdrawn from minor branch lines.

evidence.quote: Few class D engines could still be found in service on the minor DSB branch lines until around 1967

undated_mentions: start of the 1950s: class D ceased to be the freight backbone
1950s: first non-modernized D III locomotives started to be withdrawn
end of the 1950s: class D swansong as diesel deliveries (MY, MX) began
start of the 1960s: MX diesel delivery marked the swansong for class D
first half of the 1960s: massive withdrawal of class D
undated: five surviving class D locomotives preserved (D 802, D 825, D 826, D 857, D 871)
